nextcloud.card: File sync and sharing with admin account and cron
nextcloud.downloading: Downloading Nextcloud and checking its SHA-256…
nextcloud.note: Files are kept in a folder next to the project root (…-nextcloud-data), outside the web root. A 5-minute cron for cron.php is added.

prestashop.note: The install/ folder is removed and admin/ is renamed to a random name; the message after install shows the back-office address. Log in with the admin email.

opencart.note: The install/ folder is removed and system/storage moves next to the project root (…-opencart-storage). Admin area: /admin.

mediawiki.downloading: Downloading MediaWiki and verifying its GPG signature…
mediawiki.note: The download is verified with the MediaWiki release keys (needs gpg on the server). Settings are written to LocalSettings.php.
